SELECT A.id , A.title , A.content , A.post_type , A.summary , A.view_count , A.is_published_yn , A.published_at , C.key FROM posts A LEFT JOIN attachments B ON B.record_id = TEXT(A.id) AND B.record_type = 'post' AND B.name = 'thumbnail' LEFT JOIN blobs C ON C.id = B.blob_id WHERE A.post_type = 'post'
ORDER BY A.published_at DESC
ORDER BY A.published_at ASC
